rust_summary: a server command looked up by name, an alias resolved (`native_command_info`).
doc_summary: `native_command_info(label)` looks up the server's command `label` names, a mod's registered one or vanilla's with its alias resolved (Bukkit's `CommandMap.getCommand`), as a `NativeCommandInfo`: name, aliases, usages, operator level, whether vanilla has it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:command_info@.
